integration.name: jira_release
integration.description: Jira release management. Releases are project versions. GET /rest/api/3/project/KEY/version supports query/name and status filters with startAt/maxResults pagination; GET /rest/api/3/version/ID reads one version. Create with POST /rest/api/3/version using projectId and name. Update name, description, dates, released or archived with PUT /rest/api/3/version/ID. Reorder with POST /rest/api/3/version/ID/move. Read the current version and related issue counts before changes, preserve unrelated values, and verify writes. Publishing a PR does not authorize releasing a version. Delete, merge, project administration and issue writes are not allowed by this tool. Use the Jira ticket tool for fixVersions edits. Responses are wrapped in data.
